ideons.name: Nerve Shuttle
ideons.text: When commanded, swaps the first two adjacent player stacks. Corruptions stay on their spaces.

enemies.name: Nerve Weaver
enemies.signature: Starts with a Nerve Shuttle in the enemy half of the grid, then creates more. Shuttles swap adjacent player stacks on command; the opening Shuttle waits until after your first turn.
enemies.counter: Keep key formations away from the shuttle or kill it before Twitch.
